newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade minister to visit U.S. for talks.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade minister to visit U.S. for talks.

text.p: Japan's Minister of International Trade and Industry Shinji Sato said on Tuesday he will visit Washington from April 28-29 to discuss bilateral trade issues with U.S. officials.
Sato told a news conference that the United States seems to misunderstand Japan's trade practices which Washington has said contain barriers to foreign business.
Recent strong exports of Japanese cars to the United States are due to seasonal factors and a brisk U.S. economy, he said.
"I guess they (U.S. products) do not seem to be meeting the needs of Japanese consumers," he said, referring to complaints by U.S. carmakers that U.S. cars are not selling well in Japan.
